# data.docker_compose_projects

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the compose projects on the daemon, like `docker compose ls`: containers grouped by the `com.docker.compose.project` label, each with a status such as `running(2), exited(1)` and its config files.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include projects whose containers are all stopped (CLI `--all`). Default `false`. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | Hex SHA-256 of `projects_json`. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon. |
| `names` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | The project names, sorted. |
| `projects` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | Compose projects found on the host, grouped by the project label. |
| `projects_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | JSON array as `docker compose ls --format json` prints it. |
